SUPERIOR COURT OF CALIFORNIA,

NOTICE OF CASE

MANAGEMENT SYSTEM UPGRADE
The Superior Court of California, County of Fresno, will be transitioning to a new case
management system, entitled e-Court, effective April 1, 2026.
Impact on Filings
To facilitate the conversion process, please be advised of the following important deadlines
and filing requirements:
 Effective Sunday, March 1, 2026 at 11:59 PM – non-criminal electronic filings will no
longer be accepted via File & Serve.
 From Monday, March 2, 2026 through Tuesday, March 31, 2026, the Court will only
accept paper filings for all non-criminal matters, which must be accompanied by the
appropriate filing fees.
 Effective Wednesday, March 25, 2026 at 11:59 PM – criminal electronic filings will no
longer be accepted via File & Serve.
 From Thursday, March 26, 2026 through Tuesday, March 31, 2026, the Court will only
accept paper filings for all criminal matters.
Any questions regarding the status of specific filings, filing and calendaring timeframes, or
applicable filing fees should be directed to the appropriate division directly.
All documents submitted for filing must conform to the California Rules of Court Title Two.
Impact on Online Payments
Due to a system upgrade that will occur from Thursday, March 26, 2026 at 5:00 PM through
Wednesday, April 1, 2026 at 8:00 AM, the online payment system will be unavailable during
that timeframe. During the system upgrade period, payments can be made at Court locations
via cash, check, money order, or credit card – or mail via check or money order.
Impact on the Case Information Portal
The Court’s online case information portal will be unavailable from Friday, March 27, 2026 at
5:00 PM through Wednesday, April 1, 2026 at 8:00 AM.
The Court appreciates the patience and cooperation of counsel, the public, and our justice
partners as we complete the system conversion with minimal disruption.
